title: release workflow prod gate: pyproject.toml [tool.mlflow-release] version is a major.minor branch marker, never a [project].version
answers: Why does pyproject.toml have a version under [tool.mlflow-release] when the version lives in mlflow/version.py?
The python.yml release workflow prod PyPI upload failed at 'Validate ref and version' on branch-2.11 — how do I fix it?
Can I bump the version in pyproject.toml for a new patch release, or does the release gate need per-patch updates?
Where is the release branch version checked before publishing to PyPI?
body:
Path: The release-workflow version check for prod (destination=pypi) uploads. The `python.yml` "Validate ref and version" step in mlflow/releases greps the repo-root pyproject.toml for a `version = "..."` line and compares its major.minor to the release branch. The build itself is driven by setup.py reading mlflow/version.py; pyproject.toml's `[tool.mlflow-release]` table is never read by setuptools.
Rule: Keep the marker as `[tool.mlflow-release] version = "<major.minor>"` in pyproject.toml (for branch-2.11, `"2.11"`). Only major.minor is checked, so it is set once per release line and does not change for patch releases; the published version stays in mlflow/version.py. Do not add a `[project]` table or `[project].version`, because that conflicts with setup.py's dynamic version and the MLFLOW_SKINNY package-name toggle.
Symptom: The prod release job failed at the "Validate ref and version" gate on branch-2.11 because pyproject.toml had no `version = "..."` line, even though the TestPyPI build was fine (the gate is skipped for test-pypi).
Constraints: Applies only to the prod pypi destination; TestPyPI builds skip this gate and do not need the marker. Do not use this marker to set the package version or to change build metadata.
Applies: Release-branch setup and changes to the version gate in mlflow/releases python.yml, or edits to the [tool.mlflow-release] table in pyproject.toml.

says: Production release deployment fails during the version validation check while test publishing succeeds.
Publishing a patch release is blocked by the release branch version gate.
Release workflow rejects production upload because the branch marker line is missing.
Clarify whether patch updates require updating configuration version markers before publishing.
search: For production package publishing in mlflow/releases python.yml, the version gate compares the release branch against version = "<major.minor>" under [tool.mlflow-release] in pyproject.toml. This marker is set once per release branch, does not change for patch releases, and is separate from the published package version in mlflow/version.py. Do not add [project] or [project].version tables, which conflict with setup.py dynamic versioning and MLFLOW_SKINNY. The validation gate applies exclusively to production PyPI uploads and is skipped for TestPyPI destinations.
